title: Open Research Europe opens to researchers across eleven countries
organization: European Commission, DFG and participating organisations
what_changed: Open Research Europe has moved from preparation to operation. Researchers affiliated with institutions in eleven participating countries, including Germany, can now submit without either EU-project funding or author fees. The platform accepts articles, registered reports, data notes, case studies, and essays, using a Publish-Review-Curate model with public reviews. CERN operates the service.
why_it_matters: This is a substantial implementation experiment in collectively financed, fee-free European publishing. Sixteen funders and research organisations plus the Commission have committed nearly EUR 17 million for 2026-2031, including up to EUR 10 million from the Commission. For Germany, country-level participation effectively creates a national publishing entitlement independent of individual DFG funding.
